title: Pathwalks
statementMd:
You are given a directed graph with $*n*$ nodes and $*m*$ edges, with all edges having a certain weight.

There might be multiple edges and self loops, and the graph can also be disconnected.

You need to choose a path (possibly passing through same vertices multiple times) in the graph such that the weights of the edges are in strictly increasing order, and these edges come in the order of input. Among all such paths, you need to find the the path that has the maximum possible number of edges, and report this value.

Please note that the edges picked don't have to be consecutive in the input.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100000$,$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 100000$) — the number of vertices and edges in the graph, respectively.

$*m*$ lines follows.

The $*i*$-th of these lines contains three space separated integers $*a*_{*i*}$, $*b*_{*i*}$ and $*w*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $0 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 100000$), denoting an edge from vertex $*a*_{*i*}$ to vertex $*b*_{*i*}$ having weight $*w*_{*i*}$

## Output

Print one integer in a single line — the maximum number of edges in the path.

## Note

The answer for the first sample input is $2$: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/609340f155794c4e9eebcd9cdfa23c73cf982f28.png). Note that you cannot traverse ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9b1d1f66686c43090329870c208942499764a73b.png) because edge ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/030fc9181b578c2d906254d38dc56da5554323eb.png) appears earlier in the input than the other two edges and hence cannot be picked/traversed after either of the other two edges.

In the second sample, it's optimal to pick $1$-st, $3$-rd and $5$-th edges to get the optimal answer: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bd608e0d11c1e7d39405f62afde4e5a2d18cecf6.png).
statementZhMd:
给定一个包含 $*n*$ 个节点和 $*m*$ 条边的有向图，每条边都有一个权值。

图中可能存在重边和自环，且图也可能不连通。

你需要在图中选择一条路径（可以多次经过同一个顶点），使得所选边的权值严格递增，并且这些边在输入中出现的顺序也是递增的。在所有满足条件的路径中，你需要找出边数最多的路径，并输出其边数。

请注意，所选边不必在输入中连续出现。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100000$，$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 100000$）——图中顶点数和边数。

接下来有 $*m*$ 行。

其中第 $*i*$ 行包含三个以空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i}$、$*b*_{*i}$ 和 $*w*_{*i}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i}, *b*_{*i} ≤ *n*$，$0 ≤ *w*_{*i} ≤ 100000$），表示一条从顶点 $*a*_{*i}$ 到顶点 $*b*_{*i}$、权值为 $*w*_{*i}$ 的边。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出一个整数——路径中的最大边数。

## 说明

第一个样例的答案是 $2$：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/609340f155794c4e9eebcd9cdfa23c73cf982f28.png)。注意，你无法遍历![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9b1d1f66686c43090329870c208942499764a73b.png)，因为边![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/030fc9181b578c2d906254d38dc56da5554323eb.png)在输入中出现得比另外两条边更早，因此不能在另外两条边之后选择或遍历它。

在第二个样例中，选择第 $1$、第 $3$ 和第 $5$ 条边可以得到最优答案：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bd608e0d11c1e7d39405f62afde4e5a2d18cecf6.png)。
